messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday, creating a three‑day break that includes the weekend.)

| # | Holiday | Calendar Date | Observed (if shifted) | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---|---------|---------------|-----------------------|-------------------|-------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | 1 Jan 2023 (Sun) | 2 Jan 2023 (Mon) | 30 Dec 2022 – 2 Jan 2023 | 2023 New Year’s Day fell on a Sunday, so the holiday was observed on Monday 2 Jan. |
| 2 | Family Day (provincial) | 20 Feb 2023 (Mon) | — | 18 Feb 2023 – 20 Feb 2023 | Family Day is observed in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, and Manitoba. |
| 3 | Good Friday | 7 Apr 2023 (Fri) | — | 7 Apr 2023 – 9 Apr 2023 | Good Friday is a federal holiday. |
| 4 | Victoria Day | 22 May 2023 (Mon) | — | 20 May 2023 – 22 May 2023 | Victoria Day is a federal holiday. |
| 5 | Canada Day | 1 Jul 2023 (Sat) | 3 Jul 2023 (Mon) | 1 Jul 2023 – 3 Jul 2023 | Canada Day fell on a Saturday, so it was observed on Monday 3 Jul. |
| 6 | Labour Day | 4 Sep 2023 (Mon) | — | 2 Sep 2023 – 4 Sep 2023 | Labour Day is a federal holiday. |
| 7 | Thanksgiving | 9 Oct 2023 (Mon) | — | 7 Oct 2023 – 9 Oct 2023 | Thanksgiving is a federal holiday. |
| 8 | Remembrance Day | 11 Nov 2023 (Thu) | — | 10 Nov 2023 – 12 Nov 2023 | Remembrance Day is a federal holiday. |
| 9 | Christmas | 25 Dec 2023 (Mon) | — | 23 Dec 2023 – 25 Dec 2023 | Christmas Day is a federal holiday. |
|10 | Boxing Day | 26 Dec 2023 (Tue) | — | 26 Dec 2023 – 28 Dec 2023 | Boxing Day is a federal holiday. |

### Quick Summary

| Holiday | Long‑Weekend Dates |
|---------|--------------------|
| New Year’s Day | 30 Dec 2022 – 2 Jan 2023 |
| Family Day | 18 Feb 2023 – 20 Feb 2023 |
| Good Friday | 7 Apr 2023 – 9 Apr 2023 |
| Victoria Day | 20 May 2023 – 22 May 2023 |
| Canada Day | 1 Jul 2023 – 3 Jul 2023 |
| Labour Day | 2 Sep 2023 – 4 Sep 2023 |
| Thanksgiving | 7 Oct 2023 – 9 Oct 2023 |
| Remembrance Day | 10 Nov 2023 – 12 Nov 2023 |
| Christmas | 23 Dec 2023 – 25 Dec 2023 |
| Boxing Day | 26 Dec 2023 – 28 Dec 2023 |

> **Tip for your app:** If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., Family Day in Ontario vs. British Columbia), you’ll want to add a filter for the user’s province. The table above lists only the federal holidays that create long weekends across the entire country.
message.reasoning:
The user wants a list of long weekends for Canada in 2023. They want to fetch that info. We have a tool SimpleQuestion_ask that asks a question and expects an answer from a predefined set. But the user is not asking a yes/no question; they want data. The tool is not appropriate. There's no tool to fetch holiday data. We can respond with the list manually. We should provide the list of long weekends in Canada for 2023. Let's recall Canadian public holidays that create long weekends. In Canada, public holidays vary by province. But the user likely wants national holidays that create long weekends. For 2023, the federal holidays: New Year's Day (Jan 1), Family Day (Feb 20 in some provinces), Good Friday (April 7), Victoria Day (May 22), Canada Day (July 1), Labour Day (Sept 4), Thanksgiving (Oct 9), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas (Dec 25), Boxing Day (Dec 26). Long weekends: New Year's Day (if Jan 1 is Sunday, then Monday Jan 2 is observed). In 2023, Jan 1 is Sunday, so Jan 2 is observed. So Jan 1-3 is long weekend. Family Day: Feb 20 is Monday, so Feb 18-20 is long weekend. Good Friday: April 7 is Friday, so April 7-9 is long weekend. Victoria Day: May 22 is Monday, so May 20-22 is long weekend. Canada Day: July 1 is Saturday, so July 1-3 is long weekend. Labour Day: Sept 4 is Monday, so Sept 2-4 is long weekend. Thanksgiving: Oct 9 is Monday, so Oct 7-9 is long weekend. Remembrance Day: Nov 11 is Thursday, so Nov 10-12 is long weekend. Christmas: Dec 25 is Monday, so Dec 23-25 is long weekend. Boxing Day: Dec 26 is Tuesday, so Dec 26-28 is long weekend. Also, if a holiday falls on a weekend, it's observed on the following Monday. For example, Canada Day 2023 falls on Saturday, observed Monday July 3. So July 1-3 is long weekend. Similarly, Boxing Day 2023 falls on Tuesday, no shift. But the long weekend includes Dec 26-28. Also, if a holiday falls on a Friday, the weekend is extended. Good Friday is Friday, so long weekend. Remembrance Day is Thursday, so long weekend. So we can list all long weekends.

We should provide a table: Holiday, Date, Observed date, Long weekend dates. Provide explanation. Also note that some holidays are provincial only. But the user didn't specify province. We can mention that Family Day is only in certain provinces. But we can give the national ones.

Thus answer: Provide list. No tool needed.
